title: A Glasshouse for the Blue Hour
author: Elodie Nakamura
blurb: Jonah Reyes, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, has spent five years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
